question: Which yoginī of the essential secret mantra is invoked by the syllables aiṃ iṃ īṃ ūṃ?
premises: The formula contains the transmitted syllables aiṃ iṃ īṃ ūṃ.
It is designated as a root mantra.
inference: This transmitted formula is the root mantra of Saṅketasāravidyā-yoginī.
uncertainties: The leading marker 11 is retained as transmitted without interpretation.
plain_english: “Aiṃ iṃ īṃ ūṃ” — thus is the root mantra of Saṅketasāravidyā-yoginī.
